verdict.rationale: Docs confirm you can create a distinct API key (e.g., for an agent) and set a spend budget cap on that specific key (docs-16), plus per-key usage/request monitoring (docs-12, docs-30). However, there's no explicit documentation of rate-limit guardrails (requests/min or concurrency caps) per key, only spend budgets — and a community report notes budget enforcement can behave unexpectedly with BYOK/account balance interactions (vercel-ai-gateway-comm-1), suggesting the guardrail isn't purely deterministic on the agent's own key. missing for 10: explicit rate-limiting controls per key, independent confirmation that budget caps reliably halt an agent's spend without side effects.
